verdict.rationale: Canny's JavaScript SDK ties feedback to existing user accounts (canny-docs-2), and there are install docs for Companies and Custom Fields (canny-docs-23, canny-docs-20). Its MCP surface exposes ARR impact across ideas and lets you link deals to requests (canny-docs-4, canny-docs-5), so customer and revenue context sits alongside feedback for prioritization. Missing for 10: substantive docs on how company and custom-field attributes appear on posts or drive prioritization in the core app (the Companies and Custom Fields items are page titles only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
